ms.report:
Title: Escrow Smart Contracts
Outputs
Milestone 1 has the following outputs (deliverables):
・Open-source escrow smart contracts for Midnight on GitHub
・Video walk-through of the code

Acceptance criteria
The deliverables are considered “accepted” when they meet the following criteria.
・Open-source escrow smart contracts are publicly accessible → Yes
・The video walk-through demonstrates that the following actions can be done with the smart contracts
・User A can deposit funds into the escrow → Yes
・User B can connect their wallet to register the receiving address → Yes
・User A can authorize the release of funds from the escrow → Yes
・User B can receive the released funds → Yes
・A video with a resolution of at least 1280 x 720p → Yes
・The main language of the video will be English → Yes

Evidence of Milestone completion
・GitHub repository URL containing the open-source escrow smart contracts.

https://github.com/socious-io/midnight-escrow/
・YouTube video URL of the walk-through demonstration.

https://youtu.be/B0D79P8pxRU
Supplementary resource (not part of the acceptance criteria)
Documentation and User Guide (work in progress): https://socious.gitbook.io/midnight-smart-contract-library
Example Dapp: https://github.com/socious-io/midnight-escrow/tree/main/example-dapp
